Angehängt: 1 Bild

Same model. Same skill. Same task.
Completely different results.

I tested Keep the Why across 6 coding agents and 9 models.

The agent harness mattered far more than I expected.

Gemini: 10/10 in one agent, 0/10 in others.
Grok stayed consistently strong.
Some runs even fabricated compliance.

Don't benchmark only the model.
Benchmark the system you actually use.

Full matrix + lessons:
https://blog.technopathy.club/same-skill-six-agents-nine-models-what-a-real-eval-matrix-taught-me
